notes.title: Astor: Blade of the Monolith Patch 3!
notes.notes:
[h3]Hello Warriors of Gliese![/h3]

We're excited to bring you another update for Astor: Blade of the Monolith! This patch includes a variety of improvements based on your feedback and our ongoing efforts to enhance gameplay and balance.

[h3]Gameplay Adjustments[/h3]

[list]
[*] [b]Weapon Balance:[/b] Balanced various weapons, with special attention to the Gauntlets and Hammer. Adjustments aim to improve effectiveness and ensure each weapon feels distinct and powerful.
[*] [b]Construct Companions Enhancement:[/b] Adjusted Construct Companions to hit harder and exhibit more aggressive behavior in combat.
[*] [b]Boss Balance Rework:[/b] Several bosses have been reworked to provide a more challenging experience, aligning their difficulty better with regular enemies.
[*] [b]Improved Block Responsiveness:[/b] The responsiveness of the block action has been enhanced, making parries more accurate and timing-dependent.
[*] [b]Boss Attack Fixes:[/b] Fixed issues where some boss attacks could be interrupted unexpectedly, causing behavioral inconsistencies.
[*] [b]Block Drop Construct Adjustments:[/b] Increased cooldown and adjusted damage values for the Block Drop construct. Now rewards skilled players with a 1.5x damage multiplier when used with a combo of 10 or higher.
[*] [b]Aerial Combat Adjustments:[/b] Melee enemies will no longer throw projectiles while the player is performing aerial attacks, eliminating unfair interruptions.
[/list]

[h3]New Content[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]New Crystal Life Items:[/b] Added new crystal life items to the store:
[/list]
[olist]
[*] Healing Crystal
[*] Health Crystal Boost Lv 1, Lv 2, and Lv 3
[/olist]
[list]
[*] [b]New Awakening Tutorial:[/b] Added a reinforced tutorial for the Awakening mechanic to provide clearer guidance and understanding for players.
[/list]

[h3]Audio and Visual Enhancements[/h3]
[b]Combat Music Intensity:[/b] Adjusted the intensity of combat music to change more gradually based on the number of hits performed in combat, providing a smoother and more natural transition.
[b]Golem King Boss Audio:[/b] Improved audio for the Golem King boss encounter for a more immersive experience.
[b]Collision Improvements:[/b] Enhanced tree collision mechanics to improve realism and gameplay interactions.

[h3]Bug Fixes and Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Challenge and Replay Fixes:[/b] Addressed various bugs related to challenges and replay functionality.
[*] [b]Renamed map tab[/b] in adventure menu to collectables to better reflect the purpose of this section
[*] 
[/list]
We're committed to delivering the best experience possible in Astor: Blade of the Monolith. 

Your feedback continues to be invaluable to us, so please keep sharing your thoughts and experiences!

Thank you for your support and dedication to exploring the world of Gliese with us.

[h3]— The C2 Game Studio Team
[/h3]

notes.title: Astor: Blade of the Monolith Patch 1.1.0 is out!
notes.notes:
[h2]Greetings, Warriors of Gliese![/h2]

[b]We are excited to bring you the second update for Astor: Blade of the Monolith![/b] Your feedback has been instrumental in helping us identify and fix issues, as well as improve the game. We hope you continue to share your thoughts with us as you explore the mysteries and dangers of Gliese.

[h2][b]Update 1.1.0 Patch Notes:[/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44358956/228be910c3af6b1a2e860f07e1c573bd69a68c0a.png[/img]
[b]Community Feedback Implementation[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Hammer Rune Ability: [/b]Adjusted the hammer's rune ability to be more effective and responsive, ensuring it hits enemies more reliably and faces their direction when activated.
[*] [b]Additional Controller Mapping Presets:[/b] Added 2 extra presets based on feedback.
[*] [b]Improved Drowning Mechanics:[/b] Falling into deep water no longer deals damage to the player, improving the drowning mechanic for a more seamless gameplay experience.
[*] [b]Enhanced Climbing Sequences:[/b] Improved climbing sequences, particularly in the Start Camp level, to provide smoother and more intuitive traversal mechanics.
[/list]
[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Cinematic Loops:[/b] Fixed an issue where the final cinematic sequence from Kalios to Lyceum could get stuck in an indefinite loop.
[*] [b]Respawn Glitches:[/b] Resolved a rare bug where falling into water would cause the player to respawn on top of the water instead of on solid ground.
[*] [b]Character Behavior:[/b] Corrected an issue where Zan would walk out of cinematic scenes in Start Camp. Zan will now stay in place as intended. (He's not that shy anymore). 
[*] [b]Low Health Warning:[/b] Improved the low health status effect to alert players earlier, giving more time to react and heal.
[*] [b]Collectable Items:[/b] Fixed the collectable item counting in levels, which previously showed incorrect totals on the map.
[*] [b]Chapter Replay Fix:[/b] Addressed an issue in the replay chapter of "Inside the Monolith" during the fight against Haken, ensuring the encounter progresses smoothly.
[*][b]Fixed the bug with the achievement: Ultimate Life Form not triggering properly at all times. [/b](Players that already bought all the upgrades can unlock it by opening a store and waiting for a few seconds)
[/list]
We are continuously working on implementing your suggestions and addressing other reported bugs. Your support and feedback are invaluable to us, and we encourage you to keep sharing your experiences as you journey through Gliese. If you can, please leave us a review - it really helps let others know about the game!

From all of us at C2 Game Studio and TinyBuild, thank you for your continued support. We look forward to seeing you wield the Blade of the Monolith with newfound power and precision!

notes.title: Devlog #3: The Art of Astor
notes.notes:
[h2]Exploring the Art of Astor: Blade of the Monolith[/h2]

Welcome to our deep dive into the artistry behind Astor: Blade of the Monolith. In this blog, we'll delve into the evolution of the game's art style, the process behind developing characters like Astor, and the challenges and breakthroughs encountered along the way.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44358956/a598de7126e6e0cdd3098f534aa86d01ad40401e.png[/img]

[h3]Evolution of the Art Style[/h3]

The art style of Astor: Blade of the Monolith underwent significant evolution throughout its development journey. Starting with a flat toon style, the team eventually transitioned to a stylized modern rendering approach. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44358956/7a99b48844b3a7f1793290014d25b162e3ec05af.png[/img]

Early inspirations from games like Zelda Breath of the Wild set the tone, guiding the team towards a balance between shapes and color palette reminiscent of that beloved title. However, it was decided that the team wanted to avoid a cell shaded look, and later took influence from Ratchet & Clank: Rift Apart. That game inspired a shift towards adding more detail and realism while maintaining a cartoon-like visual identity resulting in the game’s captivating blend of modern rendering techniques and saturated toon-like textures that immerse players in a visually stunning world.

[h3]Balancing Realism and Fantasy[/h3]

Achieving a harmonious balance between realism and fantasy was crucial in crafting an immersive world for players to explore. By employing modern realistic rendering techniques, the team added depth and dimension to materials, enhancing the game's visual fidelity without compromising its stylized aesthetic. Careful tuning of parameters ensured that the game retained its unique style while offering high-definition details akin to modern gaming experiences.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44358956/ef7f0d24c178e68489379a1373a54f63719c002d.jpg[/img]

[h3]Developing Astor's Character Design[/h3]

Astor, the enigmatic protagonist of Astor: Blade of the Monolith, underwent an extensive process of development to ensure he felt both unique and integral to the game world. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44358956/7531b4e08beee6efd3b8089a4a60aa368edd0ee5.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44358956/c963a994c7ee8d7cd4d0ea30bfe0b9976f5e9830.png[/img]

Iterations were plentiful as the team sought to create an iconic character with whom players could relate. Ultimately, Astor emerged as a Diokek - a reflection of bravery and fragility in a genre dominated by strong heroes. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44358956/612cc6b14f34a0c1654177d664bfd8645b3d9429.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44358956/52be9ad8d55573b33708a925c3fd0d8be85f3060.png[/img]

His design speaks to the essence of humanity, embodying the potential for greatness and the pursuit of dreams.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44358956/dfca50e08b7ccf8565d6967391247aae6ddb9ce7.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44358956/526ca9bbb91c66cf9605e311307f7ab054b6e431.png[/img]

Character design in Astor: Blade of the Monolith was guided by a desire to ensure each character served a purpose within the narrative. The Diokek were  initially conceived as adversaries, but killing them felt really bad, so they evolved into a whimsical and magical race worthy of protection - and the race of the player character.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44358956/aadc30cec0a339d0d9e6ec841e193d56e0067afa.png[/img]

Conversely, the Hiltsik emerged as twisted versions of the Diokek, their creepy demeanor adding depth to the game's universe. The decision to integrate masks into the characters' bodies further enriched their identities, linking soul to form in a literal and symbolic manner.

[h3]Challenges and Breakthroughs[/h3]

The journey of creating Astor: Blade of the Monolith was not without its challenges. However, two significant decisions shaped the game's art style: making Astor a Diokek and incorporating realistic properties into materials. These choices, though daunting, ultimately propelled the game towards its final iteration!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44358956/4eab1610573574e63828089cdb557326ad6510da.png[/img]

That’s all for our art devlog, keep an eye on all of our social channels to keep up with the latest information on Astor: Blade of the Monolith!

notes.title: Devlog #2: Exploring the Mystical World of Gliese
notes.notes:
Welcome to our deep dive into the captivating world of Monolith: Requiem of the Ancients. In this devlog, we’ll explore the world of Gliese, introduce our hero, Astor, and some of the peoples who you’ll meet on your adventure! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44358956/425f6e40da8f0142abb7435a7deb22953e39a070.png[/img]

[h1]Gliese: A World Shrouded in Mystery[/h1]

At the heart of our game lies Gliese, a mystical world where a towering Monolith stands as a silent sentinel. The origins of this Monolith are shrouded in mystery, its purpose unknown to the inhabitants of Gliese. Throughout the ages, civilizations have risen and fallen, each leaving their mark on the landscape and shaping the course of history.

Buried beneath the sands of time, ancient ruins dot the landscape of Gliese, serving as a testament to the greatness of past civilizations. Some worship the Monolith as a deity, while others have dedicated themselves to unlocking its secrets. These ruins hold the key to unravelling the mysteries of Gliese and uncovering the truth behind its ancient past.

[h1]Exploring the Three Regions of Gliese[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44358956/767cd831a80a7a199e8519fe2aef45e57f904d1d.png[/img]

In our journey through Monolith: Requiem of the Ancients, we'll explore three distinct regions of Gliese:

[b]Proxima Grasslands:[/b] A lush forest teeming with vibrant foliage, bathed in the hues of red and purple. Here, nature reigns supreme, and hidden secrets lie waiting to be unearthed amidst the dense vegetation.

[b]Kalios Mountains:[/b] Towering peaks cloaked in snow dominate the landscape of the Kalios Mountains. Here, adventurers brave the treacherous terrain in search of ancient relics and the wisdom of the ancients.

[b]Xanios Desert:[/b] A vast expanse of sand stretches endlessly across the Xanios Desert, where the capital city of the makers once stood. Here, the Monolith stands tall and unchanged, a silent witness to the passage of time.

[h2]Fun Fact:[/h2]

Did you know that Gliese is named after an actual star system located 20 light-years away from Earth? While our Gliese doesn't represent any specific planet within this star system, it's intriguing to think about the possibility of discovering a world with red trees and a mystical Monolith.

[h1]Meet Astor: The Brave Protagonist[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44358956/8d8fc7a19897b170e6883db30b805d231e701fd2.png[/img]
[i][h2]“A Hero will rise from the most unlikely of places. A Hero will face evil. A Hero will emerge triumphant. A Hero will transform Gliese...”[/h2][/i]
[i][h3]— fragment from History of the Monoliths IV[/h3][/i]
Astor, a youthful Diokek, spent his days exploring the dense woods alongside his steadfast companion, Zan. While Zan's curiosity often led the way, it was Astor's unwavering bravery that propelled them forward into the depths of ancient ruins. Their adventures took an unexpected turn when Astor was bestowed with a remarkable gift: the ability to harness the boundless energy of the Monolith.

Empowered by this newfound ability, Astor embraced his role as a protector and liberator of the oppressed Diokek. With courage as his guiding force, he embarked on a daring journey to confront the Hiltsik menace and safeguard his people and friends. Astor emerged as a beacon of hope amidst the darkness, venturing into uncharted territories to secure a brighter future for all Diokek.

[h1]Unveiling the Diokek:[/h1] 

The Diokek, a gentle and peace-loving race, find solace in the hidden sanctuary of Crystal Haven, their subterranean city. While their existence echoes the ways of the enigmatic makers, much of their knowledge about this ancient civilization remains veiled in mystery and legend. Central to their beliefs is the Diokek mask, serving as a conduit between soul and body, guiding them in their journey towards the Monolith's source upon passing.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44358956/228be910c3af6b1a2e860f07e1c573bd69a68c0a.png[/img]

[h1]Encountering the Hiltsik: [/h1]

In stark contrast to the Diokek's tranquility, the Hiltsik stand as formidable warriors, imposing their dominance and oppression upon the Diokek. With a culture steeped in combat and devoid of remorse, they force many Diokek into hiding underground. Recent surges in Hiltsik activity, fueled by Astor's awakening powers, have intensified their aggression and expanded their militaristic pursuits.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44358956/21700ac6dadd7500d70d8378261313fe8975205e.png[/img]

[h1]Delving into Ancient Legends: The Mysterious Makers[/h1]

Among the shadows of history loom the mysterious makers, a civilization long vanished yet shrouded in myth and legend. Believed to be the architects of the Diokek and creators of the enigmatic structures scattered across the world, they wielded powers that bordered on magic, powered by their connection to the Monolith. Astor's quest to uncover the truth of their legacy holds the key to saving the future from the shadows of the past.

Before we sign off, w[b]e have an exciting announcement to share![/b] We're currently in the process of rebranding Monolith: Requiem of the Ancients. Stay tuned for more news and updates in the near future!

That's all for now! Thanks for tuning in to this Devlog update on Monolith: Requiem of the Ancients. Until next time, keep honing your combat skills and prepare for the adventure of a lifetime!

notes.title: Devlog #1: A look at the Monolith: RotA Combat System
notes.notes:
[b]Welcome to an exciting update on Monolith: Requiem of the Ancients development! [/b]Today, we're diving deep into the heart of the game - its combat system 

[h2]Drawing Inspiration from Legends[/h2]

Inspired by beloved classics like Devil May Cry, Bayonetta, Nier Automata, and God of War, we've crafted a combat experience that's both thrilling and accessible - we want players to feel like true powerhouses, effortlessly dispatching foes with a blend of skill and style. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44358956/200584e3ffe03e84cdd04741b84564ca6ed2e8d4.png[/img]

We've crafted the combat experience to be intuitive, allowing players to feel fully immersed in the character of Astor. Our focus on maintaining momentum ensures that each encounter feels visceral and dynamic, enhancing the overall satisfaction of engaging in combat within the game. After mastering the fundamentals, combat in Monolith: Requiem of the Ancients flows seamlessly. 

[h2]Accessibility with Depth[/h2]

One of our primary goals with Monolith's combat system was to make it accessible to newcomers while still offering depth for seasoned gamers. We've achieved this by designing combat to make it easy to keep combos going, swiftly changing from target to target, where you are provided with plenty of offensive and defensive options. Whether you're a newcomer to the genre or a veteran, we think there's something for everyone to enjoy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44358956/b869a700688c5fbde77d2b73c639ed755dbac653.png[/img]

For those of you who want to really explore the combat system, you’ll find you have an awful lot of options to choose from when dispatching your enemy. Different enemies will have different weaknesses - for example, you can use blunt weapons to destroy an enemy's shield or a strong air attack to knock a flying enemy to the ground. If you successfully combine moves together into a combo, you will get the opportunity to perform a Runic Finisher, a powerful attack which will change depending on your equipped weapon.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44358956/0a9a04c302ce42ad63b0c7ee6fa09823f92fc12a.png[/img]

Runic constructs provide an extra layer of personalization and strategy, these are abilities that you equip and enter a cooldown when used. You can summon companions, decoys, shields and even powerful AOE attacks!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44358956/5bfaa60f06ffa7b6a1062313c80749726cfdb686.png[/img]

Our combat system is all about providing choices for the players and allowing them to experience the fight as they wish. New players will stick to the basics, but experienced players will have the tools to express themselves and dispatch enemies in a deadly and efficient dance of slashes, crushes, blasts and summons. 

[h2]Weapons and Abilities[/h2]

The default weapon - a sword,  is acquired very early on in the tutorial. As the game progresses you’ll collect resources that allow you to unlock skills, including combos and finishers.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44358956/8bcbe31bd06d2cec6f01a90bd6871ed87a96207c.png[/img]

Throughout the game, you’ll discover three more types of weapons: a pair of Gauntlets, a Spear, a Hammer and a ranged attack. You’ll also unlock a power summon skill called constructs which will allow you to bring forth tornados, minions, robots and more as you progress through the game. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44358956/66d61702c58f9ee624564aeb597562f141469bfa.png[/img]

In combat, the player can simultaneously use weapon attacks, ranged attacks and summoning constructs. Both weapon attacks and ranged attacks will have light, heavy and charged attacks, which, when combined, can form powerful combos. These combos will allow you to activate Runic Finishers.

[h2]Epic Boss Battles[/h2]

Let’s be real here, what would a game like this be without epic boss battles? In Monolith, you will face off against 10 formidable bosses, each with their own distinct abilities and combat styles. These encounters will test your skills like never before, requiring quick reflexes, strategic thinking, and mastery of your chosen weapons and abilities.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44358956/64f23fcb0ad6b9dcae39a4104cd705080bdd48b2.png[/img]

[h2]Challenges Await[/h2]

The challenges don't end with boss battles. Players can also tackle a series of special challenges accessed through portals scattered throughout the game world. From facing waves of minions to rematches with bosses, these challenges offer additional opportunities for players to hone their combat prowess and earn valuable rewards. And for those looking for an extra challenge we offer a hard difficulty level and a ‘new game +’ feature.

Before we sign off, w[b]e have an exciting announcement to share![/b] We're currently in the process of rebranding Monolith: Requiem of the Ancients. Stay tuned for more news and updates in the near future!

That's all for now! Thanks for tuning in to this Devlog update on Monolith: Requiem of the Ancients. Until next time, keep honing your combat skills and prepare for the adventure of a lifetime!

notes.title: Monolith: RotA - A Realm Unveiled
notes.notes:
[i]In the ancient annals of time resides Gliese, a realm draped in mystery, where history lies cloaked in shadows and destiny teeters on uncertainty. Across its vast expanse, diverse lands paint a captivating tapestry. From the scorching desert to the vibrant grasslands, deep forests, and towering mountains, Gliese boasts a spectrum of biomes that enrich its essence. Each environment beckons explorers to unearth their secrets, discover hidden temples, explore caverns, and undoubtedly revel in the manifold wonders that Gliese holds.[/i]

[h2]BIOME: THE DESERT[/h2]
[previewyoutube=U9ke9s5SPu8;full][/previewyoutube]
[i]Stretching across a sparse and arid region, the Xanios Desert might have once been the dwelling place of Gliese’s most ancient civilization. Its proximity to the Monolith infuses it with the energy flowing from the monument.

Despite being sparsely populated, nomadic groups of Diokek call this place home. However, danger lurks in the form of frequent Hiltsik activity and the presence of aggressive giant spiders… making this area perilous to explore![/i]

[h2]BIOME: THE FOREST[/h2]
[previewyoutube=LxuXy4OkiGk;full][/previewyoutube]
[i]The Deep Forest, a realm shrouded in an aura of mystery, remains secluded and largely uncharted, veiled by an intricate vertical labyrinth of towering trees and dense foliage. This overgrown region presents a challenging landscape, where navigating the twists and turns tests even the most seasoned explorer.

Legends speak of a hidden grove where the whispers of ancient wisdom echo, guarding its secrets with a natural grandeur that entices explorers while cautioning them against the risks that lie within. Navigating these depths will require much more than courage![/i]

[h2]BIOME: THE MOUNTAINS[/h2]
[previewyoutube=TxRrncsu6GM;full][/previewyoutube]
[i]The snow-capped peaks of the Kalios Mountain Range beckon adventurers, yet their beauty masks the danger within. Harsh temperatures and fierce winds make this region challenging to explore. Hosting a small Diokek village and a unique breed of Hiltsik adapted to the freezing climate, the area faces threats beyond the creatures that inhabit it.[/i]

[h2]BIOME: THE GRASSLAND[/h2]
[previewyoutube=cgnBifJaFRo;full][/previewyoutube]
[i]Nestled within the grasslands, the Sacred Lake glistens with serene waters, while the Firefly Forest enchants with a sort of autumnal magic, both thriving within the expansive plains.

Rich with lush vegetation and sprawling forests, the Grasslands provide expansive views that captivate with their natural beauty. Home to Astor and Zan, this area is rumored to serve as the passage to a hidden Diokek City, shrouded in mystery itself.[/i]

notes.title: Monolith: RotA Steam Next Fest Recap
notes.notes:
[img]https://i.ibb.co/mCj4sPj/r54-Vc-LO-1536x864.jpg[/img]

Following the conclusion of Steam Next Fest, we’re taking a moment to express our heartfelt gratitude. We want you to know how much your participation means to us!

Steam Next Fest was designed with a singular purpose in mind – to offer the gaming community an opportunity to dive headfirst into the exciting world of upcoming indie games!

The enthusiasm and support you’ve shown for Monolith has left us thrilled and deeply appreciative. Whether it was downloading our demo, joining us for livestreams, or generously sharing your thoughts on your socials and our Discord – each action taken has a significant impact on the Monolith team.

[i]“Steam Next Fest was such an exciting moment for us at Versus Evil because, finally, gamers were able to experience what our team has been feeling since we signed this game & see for themselves just how special it is. The team at C2 Game Studio have poured so much love into Monolith: RotA, which is immediately apparent from your first touch of the controls!”[/i] – Dave Hulegaard, Senior Brand Manager at Versus Evil.

The highlight of Steam Next Fest, without a doubt, was the chance to finally place our game into your eager hands. That moment was a milestone for us! We genuinely cherish every piece of feedback we received – the praise and the constructive suggestions alike. It’s with your input that we can identify the areas that need fine-tuning and work towards making our game even better.

[i]“We were overwhelmed by the good vibes and general positive and constructive feedback we received, it helped us reinforce our direction and prioritize on some basic pain points some users reported.”[/i] – Luis Correa, Game Director C2 Game Studio.

While we are certainly excited about the progress of the game and the warm reception from our community, it’s important to remember that the demo you played is just a glimpse of a game that’s still evolving. It doesn’t represent the final, polished product that we are striving to deliver. Monolith’s demo was designed to give you a glimpse of the game’s direction. There are numerous powers waiting to be unlocked, formidable foes to conquer, and mysteries yet to reveal!

With the invaluable input from our community during Steam Next Fest, we’ve begun to take action. A handful of adjustments and fixes have already found their way into the demo patch, while the rest are set to be implemented into the final game.

Here’s a sneak peek at a few of the concerns we’ve already tackled or are determined to address before Monolith’s release:

[i]– Changed auto dash to manual dash with RT (shift on the keyboard)
– Added a camera distance slider
– Added localization to more languages
– Added input remapping
– Will improve default mappings for keyboard/mouse
– Will add an option to disable camera auto assist
– Will add an option to disable controller vibration
– Will address issues with default controller settings on Steam
– Will tweak mouse sensitivity
– Will fix exploits reported
– Will improve tutorials to clearly explain all the features[/i]

That said, due to popular demand… we’ll be keeping the Monolith demo up on Steam a little bit longer – so dive in again!

Thank you for being a part of our journey and your support for Monolith: Requiem of the Ancients!

notes.title: Monolith: RotA Meet The Demo Cast
notes.notes:
If you haven't checked out our demo from Steam Next Fest, you're in luck!

We're leaving our demo live for a bit longer - and now is the perfect time to try your hand being the hero Gliese so desperately needs!

But first, let's just in to a quick cast introduction for the characters you'll encounter in our demo!

[img]https://i.ibb.co/YTWX1Jm/7860rPCp.jpg[/img]

[b]Astor[/b]

[i]Awakening in the depths of a forgotten temple, with no recollection of his identity, our hero responds to a cryptic voice that christens him “Astor.” His quest: to uncover the elusive answers to his past and confront the malevolent forces that threaten the future.

Endowed with the ability to mold matter with his will, Astor boldly confronts the trials of his journey, determined to fulfill his fateful destiny.[/i]

[b]Zan[/b]

[i]Nurtured within the sheltered confines of his tribe, Zan’s father, the tribe’s leader, thoroughly prepared him for leadership. Yet, Zan yearned for more. He was enamored by tales of the world outside the crystalline walls of Crystal Haven. The day finally arrived when Zan resolved to venture beyond the confines, evolving into an intrepid explorer of the world beyond.[/i]

[b]The Hiltsik Army[/b]

[i]Emerging as the predominant threat in Gliese, the Hiltsik army – conceived by Haken as a substitute for the Diokek – has become the world’s most formidable adversary. These soldiers, devoid of compassion, obey orders with unwavering loyalty, making them a force to be reckoned with.

Although the Hiltsik rarely display a conscience, some suggest they harbor enigmatic customs and tribal rites of their own.[/i]

[b]Ancient Machines[/b]

[i]These self-sufficient automatons hail from the era of the Ancients, serving as sentinels guarding treasures concealed within the sanctums of the past.

The Ancient Machines, unwavering in their vigil, launch preemptive attacks against all who dare breach the sacred thresholds of these forbidden domains.[/i]

notes.title: Monolith: RotA Demo Tips & Tricks
notes.notes:
Welcome to Steam Next Fest! Our demo for Monolith: Requiem of the Ancients is live and ready for download until October 16th. We’re so excited to share it with you, and can’t wait to hear what you think!

Before you begin your journey as a budding young hero in the making, be warned that the Temple of Soma is filled with equal parts danger and mystery. But don’t worry! We’ve compiled a few tips n’ tricks to help guide you through the demo experience!

[img]https://i.ibb.co/4gZZzMY/Tips-UI.jpg[/img]

[b]Demo Tips & Tricks:[/b]

We’ve kept these pretty general to avoid any spoilers because the temple’s greatest secrets are waiting to be discovered on their own…

[b]Combat Strategy[/b] – [i]Astor will encounter a variety of different enemy types in and around the temple. Each has its own strengths and weaknesses, so be sure to observe how they each move and attack to plan out your strategy in advance. Rushing in unprepared is sure to end in defeat![/i]

[b]The Best Offense is a Good Defense[/b] – [i]Astor’s adventure begins with only a few basic attacks, which makes this a great opportunity to boost your defensive skills. Get comfortable using both block and parry to minimize damage, and practice your timing. When you time a parry just right, you’ll temporarily stagger your enemy long enough to inflict some serious damage!
[/i]
[b]Upgrade[/b] – [i]See those red crystals everywhere? Smash ‘em up to collect the orbs! These orbs are your currency and can be used at stores to purchase powerful upgrades for Astor. Add advanced attacks like heavy combos, new techniques, or even finishers. There’s nothing quite as satisfying as smashing an enemy between two giant slabs of stone![/i]

[b]The Spirit Bubble[/b] – [i]Astor possesses a special gift which allows them to traverse between realms for a limited time. Stuck on a puzzle? Perhaps visiting the spirit realm will provide the answers you seek… or maybe even ancient hidden secrets.[/i]

[b]Combat Mastery[/b] – [i]Got the basics of combat down? Awesome! Then you may have discovered that Astor’s power grows with the combo meter. The higher the combo count, the more devastating Astor’s attacks. The combo meter resets after a period of inactivity, so what do you do if your enemies are spread out too far apart? String your combos together with a ranged attack! Once Astor learns the Runic Blast ability, a whole new level of combat strategy becomes available to you.[/i]

[b]Gems / Pyramids / Shop Info:[/b]

[img]https://i.ibb.co/zh9SYjN/Tips-Green-Crystals.jpg[/img]
[img]https://i.ibb.co/gv2PWdC/Tips-Red-Crystals.jpg[/img]
[img]https://i.ibb.co/M7f2Gjy/Tips-Pyramids.jpg[/img]
[img]https://i.ibb.co/Ns6J8fv/Tips-Shop.jpg[/img]

Good luck, and don’t get discouraged! If at first you don’t succeed, practice is key, and we’re confident that you’ll be punishing those pesky Hiltsik warriors in no time at all. But don’t get too cocky. Astor’s biggest challenge yet awaits you deep inside the temple.

[i]Monolith: Requiem of the Ancients is a highly-stylized, action-RPG set within the vibrant, mystical world of Gliese. It will release on PC, PlayStation 4|5, Xbox One, Xbox Series S|X & Nintendo Switch in early 2024.[/i]

The fate of Gliese rests on your shoulders, are you ready to become the savior this world needs?

NextFest is here!

[b][h3]We're excited to announce that our demo will be available to the public throughout the entirety of Steam Next Fest, until Oct. 16th![/h3][/b]
In the demo, your journey begins as Astor, who is right at the beginning of their epic adventure!

Astor’s search for ancient secrets leads them to the Temple of Soma, a derelict structure ripe for exploration. Will you unearth the answers you seek, or will the path be fraught with peril?

Becoming the savior of the planet is a formidable undertaking, and at this early chapter in Astor’s journey, they have much to learn. A tutorial will introduce you to the fundamentals of combat, setting the stage for the challenges that lie ahead. As you progress deeper into the game, mastering these techniques becomes paramount for survival.

Nevertheless, the journey offers opportunities for growth!

Throughout the demo, you can acquire additional skills and upgrades, gradually enhancing Astor’s capabilities. Most importantly, you’ll unlock a major ability – the Runic Blast. This skill allows you to summon a surge of arcane energy with a multitude of practical uses. Whether as a ranged attack, a means to unseal doors, or even a tool to interact with mechanisms, the Runic Blast will become an invaluable asset in your quest for answers and glory.

An epic tale of good and evil is in the midst of unfolding…

Rise, young hero. The fate of a world awaits.

[i]In the sprawling expanse of the gaming world within “Monolith: Requiem of the Ancients,” there are two remarkable locations that beckon adventurers — each with its unique allure and secrets waiting to be unraveled, inviting players to immerse themselves in a world of adventure, mystery, and heroism.

Let’s explore the Xanios Desert and the mysterious Temple of Soma![/i]

[b]Xanios Desert: A Harsh and Unforgiving Realm[/b]

The Xanios Desert, a vast and unforgiving terrain, stands as a testament to nature’s raw beauty and relentless brutality. As players venture into this arid landscape, they’ll quickly realize that danger lurks around every dune. While the main paths offer a semblance of safety, the unwary traveler may find themselves face to face with the most unexpected of adversaries: spiders. These eight-legged predators strike swiftly and without warning, serving as a constant reminder that vigilance is key to survival.

Yet, amidst this harshness, a sense of life thrives. The desert is home to the Hiltsik patrols and camps, a reminder that civilization persists even in the most desolate of places.

One of the most intriguing aspects of the Xanios Desert is the presence of a Diokek tribe that calls this arid expanse home. Nestled near an oasis, this resilient tribe of desert-dwellers plays a pivotal role in Astor’s journey. It’s here that Astor forges a crucial alliance, guided by the mysterious voice that calls him forward. With their help, Astor finds the path leading to the sacred Temple of Soma.

However, Astor’s connection with the desert Diokek doesn’t end there. Later in the adventure, he returns to aid these indigenous people in a desperate quest: to uncover the reason their once-lush oasis has dried up. This quest for answers is not just an altruistic endeavor; it’s a crucial step in Astor’s overarching mission to save the world of Gliese. The Xanios Desert becomes more than just a setting — it transforms into a living, breathing part of the game’s narrative.

[b]The Temple of Soma: A Repository of Ancient Power[/b]

Deep within the heart of the Xanios Desert lies the Temple of Soma, an ancient tomb of profound significance. This temple holds a fragment of the key necessary to unlock the Temple of the Oracle, a pivotal location in the game’s narrative. As players delve into the dimly lit chambers of the temple, they will be gripped by an atmosphere steeped in history and mystery.

The Temple of Soma is a reflection of the artistry and craftsmanship of a forgotten civilization. Its grandeur is evident in the intricate carvings adorning its walls and the echoing silence that fills its sacred halls. Yet, beneath this facade of serene beauty lies a deeper purpose—one that’s tied to Astor’s quest for answers and power.

Here, in the shadowy recesses of the temple, players will encounter challenges that test both their wits and their combat prowess. The fragment of the key to the Temple of the Oracle serves as a tantalizing prize, but obtaining it will not be without peril.

As Astor embarks on his journey to unlock the secrets of the ancients and thwart the encroaching darkness, the Temple of Soma becomes a crucial milestone—a place of both discovery and danger.

notes.title: Monolith: Requiem of the Ancients Demo Is Live!
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=5M9CkuNnD2A;full][/previewyoutube]
Monolith: Requiem of the Ancients is a highly-stylized, action-RPG set within the vibrant, mystical world of Gliese. It will release on PC, PlayStation 4|5, Xbox One, Xbox Series S|X & Nintendo Switch in early 2024.

[b]We are excited to announce that a playable demo will be available to the public as of today, and throughout the entirety of Steam Next Fest that begins on October 9th![/b]

In the demo, your journey begins as Astor, who is right at the beginning of their epic adventure!

Astor’s search for ancient secrets leads them to the Temple of Soma, a derelict structure ripe for exploration. Will you unearth the answers you seek, or will the path be fraught with peril?

Becoming the savior of the planet is a formidable undertaking, and at this early chapter in Astor’s journey, they have much to learn. A tutorial will introduce you to the fundamentals of combat, setting the stage for the challenges that lie ahead. As you progress deeper into the game, mastering these techniques becomes paramount for survival.

Nevertheless, the journey offers opportunities for growth!

Throughout the demo, you can acquire additional skills and upgrades, gradually enhancing Astor’s capabilities. Most importantly, you’ll unlock a major ability – the Runic Blast. This skill allows you to summon a surge of arcane energy with a multitude of practical uses. Whether as a ranged attack, a means to unseal doors, or even a tool to interact with mechanisms, the Runic Blast will become an invaluable asset in your quest for answers and glory.

An epic tale of good and evil is in the midst of unfolding…

Rise, young hero. The fate of a world awaits.

[b]Notes & Known Issues:[/b]

[list]
[*] The demo is only available in English, but the full game will support French, German, Spanish – Spain, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese – Brazil, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Spanish – Latin America & Traditional Chinese for interface & subtitles.

[*] Although the demo is pretty solid overall, we’re still tidying up and fixing bugs. It is a work-in-progress and is not representative of the final product.

[*] We’re still applying tweaks to balance gameplay, so some elements may feel a bit too easy or too hard at times right now. Let us know how it feels to you!

[*] Control remapping is planned, but still WIP in this build.
[/list]

[b]Please Note:[/b]

[i]If you need help identifying your PlayStation button mapping from Xbox defaults or setting up your Steam Deck…

We have you covered in our Discord with step by step instructions and infographics![/i]

[url=https://discord.gg/monolithrota]Join Us On Discord[/url]

notes.title: Monolith: RotA Character Introduction - Meet Astor
notes.notes:
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExNXVsMDhmdWpuODFvcjd2Z3d6NGFocHloYW9hY3ZiOTdkdGMwb3QybSZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/3AiC2drn1RBGQpReNx/giphy.gif[/img]

A thousand years have passed since a cataclysmic event razed civilizations to the ground, leaving scars that still mar the lands. But history has a tendency to repeat itself, and once more, dark forces stir. Entities of a forgotten era, surge forth to claim the Monolith’s unparalleled power for themselves.

Though amidst this encroaching darkness, a beacon of hope stirs.

Awakening within the depths of an ancient, long-forgotten temple, our hero emerges into a world shrouded in mystery, devoid of identity. Guided by an voice that whispers the name ‘Astor,’ they embark on a quest for answers.

Prepared to wield arms against the impending threat with unyielding determination, Astor sets forth on a perilous journey, forging ahead to fulfill their destiny and to become the savior Gliese so desperately needs.

Astor’s journey is not solely about survival; it is about discovering who they are and their true purpose. Our hero’s path converges with the mysteries of the ancients – a people lost to time. As the veil over their disappearance lifts, an epic tale of good and evil, sacrifice and destiny, takes center stage.

notes.title: Monolith: Requiem of the Ancients Announced!
notes.notes:
Get ready to step into the realm of a captivating third-person action-adventure game, where you’ll be immersed in a fantastical world teeming with mysterious ancient ruins! Embark on an unforgettable quest in the world of Gliese, where ancient forces stir and dark secrets loom. Join Astor, a brave young warrior, as he unravels the mysteries of majestic ruins and temples, fighting against the odds to save his planet. Explore a vibrant and treacherous world, filled with abandoned remnants of a forgotten era, each holding tightly to tales waiting to be unveiled. Guided by a mysterious presence, Astor’s journey unveils a captivating storyline with unforgettable characters and creatures. Traverse lush forests, expansive deserts, icy tundras, and crumbling structures on a globetrotting adventure like no other.

Experience the exhilaration of Monolith: Requiem of the Ancients, with its intricate combat system. Unleash the power of ancient weapons and special abilities, mastering devastating combos. Summon the Runic Swarm, commanding constructs to aid you, or wield boulders to crush your foes. Adapt your tactics on the fly, seamlessly switching between light, heavy, and ranged attacks. Precise blocking and dodging are key, while building your combo meter leads to awe-inspiring finishers. Prepare to be captivated by the rich tapestry of combat and exploration that awaits.

If you enjoy games like Kingdom Hearts, Devil May Cry, or Ratchet & Clank – Monolith: RotA will definitely tick all the right boxes for you -and satiate your craving for an exciting Action ARPG / Fantasy ARPG!
